name: Chattrn Live Chat
author: Chattrn

sections.description:
Chattrn Live Chat connects your WordPress site to your Chattrn account and installs the chat
widget automatically. Once connected, your visitors can start a conversation with your team
directly from your site, and every conversation shows up in your Chattrn inbox alongside your
other channels.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Chattrn and log in with your Chattrn account email and password.
  3. Choose which Chattrn project you want to connect this site to.
  4. That’s it — the widget is live on your site immediately.

What data is shared

Once connected, this plugin loads the Chattrn chat widget script from asset.chattrn.com on
every page of your site (unless you exclude specific pages in the plugin settings). The widget
itself handles visitor chat interactions directly with Chattrn’s servers — this plugin’s own
role is limited to authenticating your account once and keeping the connection active. See
Chattrn’s privacy policy at https://www.chattrn.com/privacy-policy for details on how visitor chat data is
handled.

This plugin does not read, modify, or sync any WooCommerce, order, or customer data from your
site.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Chattrn”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Settings → Chattrn and log in with your Chattrn account to connect your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Chattrn account?

Yes. Sign up at https://www.chattrn.com if you don’t already have one.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

The widget will work on any WordPress site, including WooCommerce stores, but this version does
not sync cart, order, or product data with Chattrn.

Can I hide the widget on certain pages?

Yes — go to Settings → Chattrn and add one URL or path per line to the “Hide the widget on
specific pages” field.

What happens if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating disconnects the widget from your site. Deleting the plugin also removes all
locally stored settings from your WordPress database.
